notes.title: Oculus Touch Turn/Teleport.
notes.content: A small update. Turn and Teleport now on different sticks with the Oculus Touch controllers.

notes.title: Hint System Enabled
notes.content: Subtle hint system is now live with a small update today. Was a debate we had with beta testers before launch 50/50 on each side. As a request from some users we turned on the hint system. We want everyone to explore all areas without getting lost. Enjoy the holiday sale. We are working on a larger update for 2020 that adds an open streaming world and expanded story. To have Early Access and follow development just go to the games preferences and select the beta version.

notes.title: HD Rendering Update
notes.content: Updated with a new rendering post processor. Now with sharper HD image on surfaces with less GPU call times. Improved frames per second and overall image quality.

notes.title: Update 1.0.3.9
notes.content: Had a rotate issue with Index Knuckles Controllers. moved the rotate function away from the grip sensors. Rotate is now on the joysticks only for the Index Knuckles Controllers.
